# Roasted Veg, Ricotta and White Bean Pasta Sauce (DRAFT / experiment)

Serves about 4. About 45 minutes. A blended, creamy, vegetable-heavy sauce with protein from ricotta and beans. Draft idea to refine this afternoon; quantities are a starting point.

## Ingredients
- 300-400g pasta (penne, spirals or rigatoni hold sauce well)
- 3 carrots, chopped
- 1 red capsicum, chopped
- 1-2 zucchini, chopped
- 1 brown onion, wedges
- 4 garlic cloves, unpeeled or whole
- 1 x 400g tin white beans (cannellini), drained. Or 1/2 cup red lentils, simmered separately until soft.
- 150-250g ricotta (or cottage cheese)
- Big handful baby spinach
- 1 lemon (zest and juice)
- Dried mixed herbs, olive oil, salt, pepper (from home)
- Optional: chilli flakes, parmesan or a little mozzarella on top, a splash of balsamic, toasted seeds for crunch

## Method
1. Heat the oven to 200C. Roast the carrot, capsicum, zucchini, onion and garlic with oil, salt and herbs for 30-35 minutes, until soft and a bit charred.
2. Boil the pasta. Keep a cup of the pasta water, then drain.
3. Blend the roasted veg (squeeze the garlic out of its skins) with the beans, ricotta, a splash of pasta water, lemon juice and zest. Add more water until it is saucy.
4. Return the sauce and pasta to the pot over low heat. Stir in the spinach until wilted. Season.
5. Finish with parmesan, chilli or seeds if using.

## Notes
- Taste and adjust: lemon for brightness, a pinch of sugar or splash of balsamic if the veg are not sweet enough.
- Variations: swap the carrot for pumpkin or beetroot (pink sauce); use feta instead of ricotta for a saltier sauce; add the leftover chicken from the sheet-pan dinner.
- Overlaps with the current list: carrots, capsicum, zucchini, onion, garlic, spinach, lemon. Only the ricotta (or cottage cheese) and beans or lentils are new.
- Inspiration: Budget Bytes feta pasta, Barilla ricotta and garden veg sauce, Live Eat Learn cottage cheese sauce, Up Beet Kitchen white bean pasta, Whip & Wander beet ricotta.

- Alternative: Annalisa White Beans Cannellini 400g, $1.90 (47882)
